data.long_meaning: The name Taber is derived from the Hebrew language and is composed of two parts: ‘tab’ meaning ‘to pour out’ and ‘er’ meaning ‘God’. This name is often translated as ‘God is my protector’ or ‘God has poured out’. In the Bible, the name Taber is not explicitly mentioned. However, it is related to the name Tabor, which is mentioned in the Old Testament.
